# Visa Migrate (OZ Sponsor Jobs)

> Premier Australian Visa Sponsorship Job Aggregator & Verified Employer Directory

Visa Migrate (https://www.visamigrate.com) is Australia's dedicated programmatic employment platform connecting qualified international professionals and onshore migrants with accredited Australian Standard Business Sponsors offering genuine employer-sponsored work visas.

All vacancies featured on the platform are pre-audited for visa eligibility, accredited sponsor credentials, and compliance with the Australian Department of Home Affairs regulations.

## Australian Employer-Sponsored Visa Subclasses Covered

- **Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage - TSS Visa)**: Allows Australian employers to address certified labour shortages by bringing in genuinely skilled workers where qualified Australians cannot be found. Pathways include Short-Term, Medium-Term, and Labour Agreement streams, providing a direct transition pathway to permanent residency via Subclass 186 ENS after 2 years.
  - Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/subclass-482-tss-jobs.html
- **Subclass 186 (Employer Nomination Scheme - ENS Direct PR)**: Grants permanent residency directly to skilled workers nominated by an approved Australian employer. Streams include Direct Entry (DE) and Temporary Residence Transition (TRT).
  - Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/subclass-186-ens-jobs.html
- **Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional - Provisional)**: Enables accredited regional Australian employers to sponsor skilled workers to address regional skills needs. Offers a 5-year provisional visa with a dedicated pathway to Permanent Residence (Subclass 191) after 3 years.
  - Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/subclass-494-regional-jobs.html
- **DAMA (Designated Area Migration Agreements)**: Specialized regional migration agreements providing visa concessions (salary, age, language) across regional South Australia, Northern Territory, Far North Queensland, Pilbara, and Regional Victoria.
  - Directory: https://www.visamigrate.com/visas/dama-visa-sponsorship-jobs-australia.html
